fact: Car 11 collided with Car 18 in Turn 16
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), the driver of Car 11 (Sergio Perez), team representatives and reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 11 attempted to overtake Car 18 on the inside into Turn 16 and both cars made contact. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 18 took a reasonable line into the corner and therefore was not at fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Felix Holter Matthew Selley ### Pedro Lamy Paul Ng
title: Decision Car 18 Alleged Causing A Collision With Car 11
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
